description: Defines abstractions for write streams, including base classes, options, and utility functions for stream operations in the quiche library.

classes.name: TerminableStream
classes.description: Base class for streams supporting abrupt termination.

classes.name: WriteStreamVisitor
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about write stream events.

classes.name: StreamWriteOptions
classes.description: Options for writing data into a stream, including whether to send a FIN.

classes.name: WriteStream
classes.description: Abstract class representing a writable stream of bytes with methods for writing data and checking writability.

methods.name: AbruptlyTerminate
methods.description: Terminates the stream abruptly with an error.

methods.name: OnCanWrite
methods.description: Notification callback when the stream can accept more data.

methods.name: Writev
methods.description: Writes a vector of string views into the stream.

methods.name: CanWrite
methods.description: Checks if the stream is ready for writing.

methods.name: SendFin
methods.description: Sends a FIN to indicate end of stream.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Convenience method to write a single string view into the stream.
